intro: Taiwan is a high-tech powerhouse and makes most of the world's most advanced computer chips.

chapters.title: Silicon island
text: TSMC, based in Hsinchu, manufactures chips for Apple, Nvidia and many others. Taiwanese firms like Foxconn assemble electronics worldwide.

chapters.title: Other industries
text: Taiwan also makes bicycles (Giant), laptops (Acer, Asus) and machinery.

keyTerms.meaning: Material used to make computer chips; also another word for a chip.

cardGroups.title: Made in Taiwan
cardGroups.intro: Some of the things Taiwan makes and sells to the world.
